unexplained.lead: calc_rules.stitchdesk_backing, from the page script; Backing size = quilt size + 2 x overhang on each dimension. Usable width = fabric width minus 2 in selvage. One panel if the backing dimension fits within usable width; otherwise panels = ceil(dimension / (usable width minus 2 x seam allowance)). Both seam directions are compared and the smaller yardage is chosen (panels x cut length / 36), rounded up to the next 1/8 yd. Batting = quilt size + 2 x batting overhang, matched against a precut list. Read from the page's public /assets/calc.js.
